df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure

scatter.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)

# Set the legend title

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a scatter plot to show the relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep
# Color the points by BMI Category
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='BMI Category', style='Gender', palette='Set2')

# Set the axis labels and title
scatter.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
scatter.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
scatter.set_title('Relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep by BMI Category and Gender', fontsize=14)

# Set the legend title
plt.legend(title='BMI Category & Gender', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
